name: Rose Gold
description: Copper tier. Set bonus: Lucky Charm

pages.title: Rose Gold
pages.text:
An elegant alloy of gold and copper, built for enchanting.

- **Tier:** Copper
- **Durability:** 180
- **Sword damage:** 4.5
- **Armor (full set):** 11

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: In the [Alloy Forge](entry://alloy_forge/alloy_forge), 3 gold ingots and 1 copper ingot make 2 Rose Gold Ingots.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Gold's strengths, fixed:** fast mining (faster than iron) and very high enchantability (22 for tools, 25 for armor), with far more durability than gold.
- **Piglin-friendly:** piglins treat rose gold armor like gold armor and stay neutral.

pages.title: Lucky Charm
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** 25%% more experience from experience orbs, and enchanting tables give better offers, as if 3 more bookshelves surrounded them.
